name: Elder Mytherceria: Steal the Mind (Mytherceria, Advanced)

system.duration: One hour per Willpower Trait spent
system.activation: Through eye contact and a Willpower Trait, win a Mental Challenge to gain full temporary access to a victim's memories, rendering him comatose or torporous while you hold them; you may extend the duration by spending more Willpower, but you also suffer Oblivious penalties from carrying two minds.
